description:
Port-map §5. Two tools:

- grep.ex — prefers ripgrep (`rg`) via `System.cmd` for speed;
  falls back to a pure-Elixir scan if rg isn't on PATH.
- find.ex — glob/path patterns via `Path.wildcard/2` or `fd` if
  available.

Both respect session cwd. Honor .gitignore when using rg.
Output truncation: cap results at N matches with a truncation
marker.

TDD:
- grep: finds pattern, multiple matches, regex, case-insensitive,
  .gitignore skipped, rg-not-on-PATH fallback
- find: glob pattern, recursive, exclude .git

Depends on .1.
title: Search tools: grep (rg shell-out) + find (glob)
